parts.text: Edit this image: REMOVE the saw weed whacker and its engine pack completely; she holds nothing and carries nothing. Both hands are raised in front of her chest, flexing all TEN long bloody blade nails like claws, fingers spread, both hands and every one of the ten nails clearly visible. Turn her body to three-quarter view with her head and face turned about 45 degrees toward the viewer s right. Keep her slender adult woman body, the stitched doll toy face mask, gauged ears, buzzed scalp, deep brown skin, ragged plum greatcoat and the blood splatter backdrop exactly the same. No text.
